_meta.recorded_for: TaskMaster #92 - the neighbourhood adapters are tested against recorded responses
_meta.note: Every body below is the provider's own answer, field names as the provider sends them. The 'adapter_query_*' entries are the queries the adapters build themselves; the provider rejects them with HTTP 400 and a parse error (the Overpass QL union needs the element type on every term). The 'valid_query_*' entries are the same tag sets written as valid Overpass QL, so the adapters' field mapping can be covered by a test. The adapters are not changed by this fixture - the defect is reported, not fixed.
